snippet_primary: "Currency Conversion Fees: If you're selling to customers in different countries, Gumroad charges a currency conversion fee. All transactions are processed in US dollars, so if you sell in another currency, Gumroad will convert it to USD at the time of the transaction. The exact fee for this conversion depends on the rates set by Gumroad's payment processors."
